arabic text: HAYE SHAAM WALAY, KHOONI MANZAAR KIWAIN VEKHE\nABID NAY.
english translation text: Alas, how did Abid witness\nthe blood-soaked scenes of Shaam?

arabic text:
SIR SANGAAN TAY CHAR KAY HAY LAASHA NAY
GAIYAAN
BEMAAR HI JANAY KIWAIN DAFAAN EY HOIYAAN
HAYE SHAAM TAYE PIYU DAY QATAL KIWAIN VEKHE
ABID NAY.
english translation text:
The heads were raised upon spears while
the bodies were left behind. Only the
ailing Imam knows how they were buried.
How did Abid witness the journey to
Shaam and the killing of his father?

arabic text:
GAL TOUQ TAY BEHRI BEMAAR DAY KAARIYAAN
TAKH SHAAM NU AKHIYAAN TAIYO LOUH DIYAAN
JAHRIYAAN
WICH BAZAARAN DAY HASTE SHAAMI KIWAIN VEKHE
ABID NAY.
english translation text:
A heavy collar and chains weighed upon
the ailing Imam. His eyes burned like
iron as he gazed toward Shaam.
How did Abid witness the people
of Shaam laughing in the marketplaces?

arabic text:
TERI QAID EY VAKHRI NA ROWI SAKINA
TU KHAKH TEY SOUNA NAHI EY BABAY DA SEENA
HAYE SABAAR TERAY BHAIN MERI KIWAIN VEKHE ABID
NAY.
english translation text:
‘Sakina, do not weep—you will be imprisoned separately.
You must sleep upon the dust, not
upon your father’s chest.’ Alas, how did
Abid watch my sister bear all this?

arabic text:
TUR DUNIYA TOH CHALLEYA JERA KHOON SI RONDA
AJJ VEREYA AKHIRI KOI APNA TEY HONDA.
HAAL BAQIR DAY HAI YATEEMA WALLAY VEKHE ABID
NAY.
english translation text:
The one who wept blood departed from this world.
O brother, at the final moment there should be
at least one loved one nearby. Abid saw
Baqir’s condition become like that of an orphan.

arabic text:
KOI QAIDI MOMIN MUMTAZ NA HOWAY.
BE WARISSAAN WANGOU PARDES NA ROWAY.
HAYE GHAIRAAT DAY ZAKHME SARAY KIWAIN VEKHE
ABID NAY.
english translation text:
May no believer ever become a prisoner in
Shaam, nor weep in exile like one
without an heir. Alas, how did Abid
endure all the wounds to his honour?
